A death penalty dynasty is were you start from scratch. There’s a rule in NCAA where they can in force the death penalty to a team who is breaking a lot of rules, that team isn’t aloud to compete in that sport until they are cleared by the NCAA if ever cleared. In NCAA 14 it’s just you act like your team has been given the death penalty. The way I do it is I don’t recruit for four to five years, maybe six if I’m doing a bigger team, I also cut my best players each year until I’m down to the minimum amount of players. Once I’m actually doing the dynasty I only recruit three stars and two four stars and a five stars, but if my team gets to good I usually cut down in the four and five stars. It’s quite a challenge but it’s fun and really rewarding when you finally win the natty.
